This bean plot is rented, so I do not want to put too much money into it — whoever owns the land could take it back. Beans do not need much fertilizer like maize does, they feed themselves from the soil, so I will maybe buy a small amount of DAP at planting if the cooperative has it in time, but no urea. I save my own seed from last year's harvest like my mother taught me; improved bean seed is hard to find here and costs too much. My daughters and I will do most of the weeding ourselves, and I will only hire a few people with oxen for ploughing since I do not own a pair.
